title: Greek Shrimp Skewers with Crunchy Greek Salad
description: A simple and flavorful gluten-free recipe featuring succulent shrimp skewers paired with a crunchy Greek salad.
instructions: Thread shrimp onto skewers, leaving space between each shrimp.
Brush shrimp with kissed olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill shrimp for 2-3 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, mix together crunchy breadcrumbs, Greek yogurt, and crushed red pepper flakes (if using).
Dip cooked shrimp into breadcrumb mixture to coat.
Serve shrimp skewers with Greek salad mix and lemon wedges on the side.
For the salad, combine Greek salad mix, lemon juice, and a pinch of salt and pepper in a bowl.
Toss to combine and adjust seasoning to taste.
